provider_usage.scope: Imported measured usage only; availability does not establish complete coverage of all runs.

limitations: Purposive targets: no population confidence intervals or universal winner.
HTTP transport time includes subprocess setup and transfer but excludes client reasoning; end-to-end wall time includes orchestration and quota interruptions where recorded.
Wire bytes count encoded response bodies only, not headers/TLS.
o200k extracted tokens are a declared proxy, not Luna usage/billing tokens.
Historical raw temporary traces were lost after restart; durable new traces stay private. Export URL hashes cannot be followed.
Calibration and infrastructure interruptions are separate from scored keyboard outcomes.
